newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Coms21 sets NZ on-line betting deal.
newsitem.headline: Coms21 sets NZ on-line betting deal.

text.p: Technology design group Coms21 Ltd said on Thursday it has entered into an agreement with the New Zealand Totalisator Agency Board (NZTAB) for the development and operation of an interactive gaming and wagering system.
Under the terms of the agreement NZTAB will fund the development of technical interfaces between their racing and sports betting systems and the IWN interactive gaming & wagering system, Coms21 said.
"Once the necessary interfaces are complete, NZ-TAB will offer a comprehensive international wagering service via the Internet," it said.

Coms21 said it expects that the service will be operational by third quarter of 1997. The Australian company said the five year agreement was through its New Zealand unit IWN New Zealand. It said in addition to betting on all New Zealand and many Australian races, NZ-TAB offers fixed-odds sports betting on rugby league and rugby union, Australian Footbal League, tennis, golf, American Football, soccer, basketball and motor racing.
IWN will be paid a commercial percentage of all turnover generated via the service, Coms21 said.
At 2.55 p.m. (0455 GMT), Coms21 shares were two cents lower at 48 cents. -- Sydney newsroom 61-2 9373-1800
